steps.title: Voice & Positioning Interview
steps.desc: A focused 45-minute call to capture how you actually think, the stories only you can tell, and the angle that makes you distinct from every other founder posting generic advice.

steps.title: Content Calendar & Ghostwriting
steps.desc: From that single interview, we write 4–8 LinkedIn posts a month in your voice, not a template, built around the angles that build authority with your specific buyers.

steps.title: Review & Publish
steps.desc: You review and approve every post before it goes out. Once approved, we handle scheduling and publishing so nothing slips or gets forgotten in a busy week.

steps.title: Engagement & Inbound Tracking
steps.desc: We track who's viewing your profile, engaging with your posts, and reaching out, and flag warm inbound signals so you know exactly who's paying attention.
